Bill.BriefDescription: Forfeiting lead agency status for nonperformance.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to lead agency status for the construction oftransportation projects; and adding a new section to chapter 47.28 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 47.28 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: A county designated as the lead agency for the construction of atransportation project that fails to perform the duties required of itas a lead agency within a reasonable time from the applicable datesestablished in the agreement governing the project shall forfeit itslead agency status and shall remit any funds previously provided to itfor the project to the department. This section does not apply if theforfeiture is inconsistent with any federal requirements that are aprescribed condition for the allocation of federal funds to the stateor the county.
